categories_thin: Med spas / aesthetic injectables - still no standalone med-spa premises found inside the township. Aesthetic injectables are offered inside dental and dermatology practices instead: Derma Laser Center (own contact page lists Botox/fillers) and Aura Dermatology's Somerset office (aesthetic and body-contouring services). The Art of Dentistry and Spa listed injectables but was removed from this list as a Dental365 chain office.

Day spas - thin but not empty: La Perle Spa & Salon (994 Easton Ave) and Caribbean Touch Spa (149 Pierce St) are the only day-spa style businesses found; other 'spa' names here are nail or hair salons adding spa services, plus massage studios. Hand & Stone at 441 Elizabeth Ave is a national chain and was excluded.

Yoga studios - no dedicated commercial yoga studio found in the township. Tall Pine Yoga advertises a Somerset address on Pasture Trail, a residential street, so it was treated as home-based and left out; other results were studios in North Brunswick, Bound Brook, Edison and Warren.

Veterinarians - three now (Cedar Lane Animal Clinic, Easton Animal Clinic, Faith Veterinary Clinic Services); the surrounding cluster sits in Bridgewater, South Plainfield, Piscataway and Metuchen. Faith Veterinary is the thinnest entry - directory listing only.

Optometrists/ophthalmologists - corrected from the earlier draft: three independent optometry practices trade in the township (Franklin Family Eyecare, JW Eyecare, Eyecare on Easton) plus one solo ophthalmologist (Dr. Bradley Phillips) and a dental/medical corridor of eyewear sellers. A fourth directory entry, 'Somerset Eye Care LLC', was dropped because the practice's own site places it in North Brunswick (see data_gaps).

Physical therapy - corrected: three independent PT practices were missing and are now listed (Physical Therapy & Wellness @ Somerset, Comprehensive Orthopedic Physical Therapy, Dynamic Rehab Physical Therapy). Regional brands still dominate the rest of the category (Ivy Rehab, Trinity Rehab, Professional PT, Atlantic PT, Alliance) and the chain clinics were removed from this list.

Dermatology - two practices now: Dermcare (directory records only, no website found) and Aura Dermatology's Somerset office. Rutgers Health Dermatology and Schweiger are hospital-system/large-group offices and were excluded.

Therapy / counselling - plenty of solo practitioners advertise Somerset 08873, but a large share are telehealth-only (the Institute for Family Services is explicitly online-only) and the in-person ones cluster in the 13 Clyde Road suite building, so the count of real local rooms is small.
caveats: Somerset is a postal name, not a municipality: mail addressed to Somerset 08873 is delivered in Franklin Township, so every 'Somerset' address here is inside the zone. Franklin Park (08823) and East Millstone are also postal names inside the township.
The 10-mile radius from central Milltown covers the whole township (farthest edge, near Griggstown/Kingston, is roughly 9-10 miles out), so nothing was cut for distance.

Chains and branded clinics removed in this revision at the verifier's direction: Dental Care Somerset and The Art of Dentistry and Spa (Dental365), The Smilist Dental Somerset, Professional Physical and Hand Therapy - Somerset, Atlantic Physical Therapy Center - Somerset. Also excluded as national/regional chains or franchises: Crunch Fitness, Planet Fitness, Sport Clips, Fantastic Sams, The Max Challenge, Ivy Rehab, Hand & Stone, Trinity Rehab, Target Optical, Visionworks, America's Best, CityMD, AFC Urgent Care, PetSmart grooming, Club Pilates, LA Fitness.

D'Angiolillo Chiropractic Center (11 Clyde Rd Suite 103) closed on 16 Oct 2026 when Dr. D'Angiolillo retired; the practice merged into Campbell Chiropractic Center from 19 Oct 2026. Its own site announces the closure, and Campbell's own contact page gives an East Brunswick address, so no Somerset successor office is listed. That suite is therefore vacant.
Where phone is 'Unknown', the directories used do not publish it; triage should pull it from the business's own site or Google profile.

Many Somerset businesses share building addresses (441 Elizabeth Avenue salon suites, 853/745/695 Hamilton Street, 994 Easton Avenue, 13 Clyde Road therapy suite, 75 Veronica Avenue medical suites, 900 Easton Avenue suites). They are listed separately because they are separate businesses, but expect a shared landlord rather than a duplicate.

Three suspected duplicate pairs were resolved this revision: R & J Glamour / Juanita's (one entry), Don Andres / Golden Luxury Cuts (one entry), Somerset Family Dental / Dr. Robert E. Rozencwaig (one entry). The pair Mane Appeal / Hair We Are turned out to be different street numbers (695B vs 681 Hamilton St) and both were kept. Cutters / LoczbyLiz / La Perle share a building but are separate businesses.

'Franklin Township' searches constantly pull in Franklinville (Gloucester County) and Franklin borough (Sussex County) results; all such entries were filtered out by address. A few township businesses at the tail of those directory lists may therefore be missing, and BestProsInTown's 'Franklin' pages mix the two.
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API was unreachable (two mirrors timed out), so no OSM sweep was done.

Yellow Pages, Manta, ChamberofCommerce.com, Cybo, FindOpen, LocalityBiz and loc8nearme category pages returned HTTP 403 / Cloudflare blocks via fetch; a few individual loc8nearme profiles did load and were used.
Google Maps in the browser served only a four-result 'limited view' per query and would not scroll or paginate, so Maps could not be used for a full sweep of any category.
BestProsInTown lists roughly 3-20 businesses per category (it appears to cap the list), so tail-end listings in dense categories (nail salons, barbershops, hair salons) may be incomplete.
No township-issued business licence, registry or economic-development directory covering these categories was found on franklintwpnj.org.
